name: ROBOKIDZ
about: Robokidz Eduventures Private Limited provides robotics and coding education through various courses and workshops. The company offers Autobot Basic Level, Autobot Intermediate Level 1, Autobot Intermediate Level 2, Mechano Basic Level, Elex Basic Level, and a mentor program. It serves schools, educational institutions, and individual students in India. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Pune, India.
